clips.title: The story
paras: Skull Rock is a cavern tucked into the eastern coastal cliffs of Durotar, just east of Orgrimmar. It serves as a fortified coven for the demonic Burning Blade cult right under the capital's nose.

Hidden beneath the crags of northeastern Durotar, Skull Rock is one of the most perilous strongholds of the Burning Blade cult in the region. Dark cultists, fel-worshipping orcs, and summoners gather deep within the winding tunnels to practice demonic arts and weave conspiracies against the nascent Horde. The cell is led by the dangerous warlock Gazz'uz, whose operations pose an imminent threat to the nearby gates of Orgrimmar and travelers traversing the eastern shoreline.
